title: Make one prompt produce a tested, playable game
outcome: A creator describes a strategy game combining cards, dice, resources, turns and player choices; the app orchestrates generation, playtesting and repair internally before opening the playable result.
acceptance: Wire the existing game-quality and refinement harness into the real creation route, not just a test-only entry point.
Reject structurally valid games whose scripts do not run or whose actions cannot make progress; return actionable errors and preserve request metering.
Use a configured capable model without machine-specific default model paths or unsupported promises of live availability.

Exercise a generated game from creation through actual browser play, including negative cases and recorded evidence. A handcrafted demo or mocked provider alone does not establish live one-shot quality.

title: Generate memorable names and genuine raster cover art with each game
outcome: The game name, thumbnail and theme form coherent packaging that makes a player want to try the generated game.
acceptance: Choose and validate a distinctive name that reflects actual mechanics and theme; avoid generic placeholder names.
Integrate a server-side raster image-generation provider into the creation pipeline and save validated images with the immutable release.
Verify actual image bytes, dimensions, aspect ratio, theme consistency and thumbnail readability; SVG shapes converted to PNG do not qualify as generated illustration.
Keep secrets off the browser and never label an unconfigured or failed image provider as successful artwork generation.

title: Discover and import coherent online 3D models, textures and artwork
outcome: Generation selects suitable online assets and turns them into performant, attributed assets in a playable release.
acceptance: Connect the asset search harness to generation and an editor review surface, including provenance and applicable attribution.
Import self-contained GLB models, normalize scale and orientation, and enforce scene geometry, texture and file-size budgets.
Use thematic consistency and readability checks when selecting assets; verify the actual imported model renders in a browser.
Exercise provider outages, missing assets and malformed imports without producing a falsely complete game.

title: Source, edit and master sound effects and music for generated games
outcome: Card, dice, resource, turn and victory actions have coherent sound design, with optional mastered music and accessible controls.
acceptance: Connect online audio search and the FFmpeg mastering harness to the generation asset pipeline.
Trim unusable silence, normalize measured loudness, preserve true-peak headroom, add appropriate fades and validate loops.
Support separate music/effects levels, mute persistence, gesture-based audio activation, hidden-tab behavior and cleanup.
Test actual decoding and playback plus clipping, repetition and layering; attach audio samples and browser evidence for listening review.

title: Evaluate complete generated strategy games for bugs and playability
outcome: The creation pipeline finds broken rules, soft locks, inaccessible controls and pacing problems before a creator sees the result.
acceptance: Play multiple seeds and legal choices from setup to victory with two to four clients; verify deterministic convergence and reconnect recovery.
Check turns, resources, trading, legal actions, progress, reachable win conditions and post-victory behavior.
Capture screenshots, action histories, timing and audio evidence; turn discovered bugs into permanent regressions.
Report decision variety, downtime and completion length as measurable signals, and include a human playtest rubric. Do not claim automated tests prove fun.

title: Complete and verify the real prompt-to-publish player experience
outcome: A person supplies one idea and receives a cohesive game that looks and plays well, can be shared, and works for invited players.
acceptance: Run the real configured generation and media providers end to end; no demo substitution or mocked success in acceptance evidence.
Verify generated title, raster thumbnail, rule explanation, themed assets, mastered audio and full multiplayer game completion.
Exercise desktop and mobile navigation, loading states, recoverable errors, sign-in, publication and invite joining.
Record limitations and failed creative playtests honestly and queue focused follow-up work.
